Evaluation stage is internally consistent and passes all integrity checks. No deterministic findings. Verification summary:

(1) Data & splits: 28×28×3 RGB, 9-class multi-class, splits 89,996/10,004/7,180 consistent with standard PathMNIST. Train/val overlap = 0; test not inspected during training; test_metrics_used = false. All 11 data-audit checks passed.

(2) Architecture: tiny_cnn (CNN family), depth=3, hidden=96. Generic transformer fields (num_heads, patch_size, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers, pooling, mlp_ratio) are present in the config but inactive for CNN families — they do not alter topology. Augmentations (hflip, brightness, contrast) are built-in primitives requiring no extension approval.

(3) Training: 15 epochs completed, best at epoch 13 (val_acc 0.988705). Cosine LR schedule confirmed in history. Early stopping patience=3 is reasonable given the plateau observed from epoch 11 onward. The ~0.23 pp gap between best_configuration.validation_accuracy (0.991004) and train_result.best_val_accuracy (0.988705) is attributable to stochastic variance between the replay and training runs — within expected tolerance.

(4) Evaluation metrics cross-check: Confusion matrix row sums match per-class supports (total 7,180). Diagonal sum 6,604/7,180 = 0.91978 ✓. Balanced accuracy (mean recall) = 0.88598 ✓. Macro F1 = 0.88370 ✓. ROC AUC OVR macro 0.978346 is consistent with the accuracy and class distribution.

(5) Prediction artifact: sha256 pinned, includes logits/probabilities/targets, 7,180 test samples confirmed.

Warnings (non-blocking):
- llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama) across all LLM-assisted stages; exact model weights are not pinned, creating a traceability gap for full reproducibility of LLM-assisted decisions. Recommend pinning the digest in a future run.
- Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) shows notably low recall (0.439) and F1 (0.585), with 87 misclassified as smooth muscle and 71 as debris. This is a model-quality observation, not a pipeline integrity defect, but warrants attention if this class is clinically important.
- Cosmetic: typo in architecture research ('E channel' → 'G channel'); compact_conv_token_transformer proposal description truncated in artefact record; ingestion comment uses 'multi-label' where 'multi-class' is correct. No functional impact.

No deterministic findings. No blocking issues. Pipeline is ready to proceed.
